=={{header|FreeBASIC}}==
<syntaxhighlight lang="freebasic">' version 22-10-2016
' compile with: fbc -s console
' for boundry checks on array's compile with: fbc -s console -exx

' sort from lower bound to the highter bound
' array's can have subscript range from -2147483648 to +2147483647

Sub sattolo_cycle(a() As Long)

    Dim As Long lb = LBound(a)
    Dim As ULong n = UBound(a) - lb +1
    Dim As ULong i, j

    Randomize Timer

    For i = n -1 To 1 Step -1
        j =Fix(Rnd * (i))       ' 0 <= j < i
        Swap a(lb + i), a(lb + j)
    Next

End Sub

' ------=< MAIN >=------

Dim As Long i, array(1 To 52)

For i = 1 To 52 : array(i) = i : Next

Print "Starting array from 1 to 52"
For i = 1 To 52
    Print Using " ###";array(i);
Next : Print : Print

sattolo_cycle(array())

Print "After Sattolo_Cycle"
For i = 1 To 52
    Print Using " ###";array(i);
Next : Print : Print


' empty keyboard buffer 
While InKey <> "" : Wend
Print : Print "hit any key to end program"
Sleep
End</syntaxhighlight>
